name: Byline Bancorp, Inc. Common Stock
description: Byline Bancorp Inc is the holding company for Byline Bank, a full-service commercial bank serving small-and-medium sized businesses, financial sponsors, and consumers. The company offers a broad range of banking products and services to small and medium sized businesses, commercial real estate and online account opening to consumer and business. Also provide trust and wealth management services to its customers. In addition to traditional commercial banking business, company provide small ticket equipment leasing solutions through a wholly-owned subsidiary of Byline Bank.
